CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.archive_sicoob_approval_deliveries(p_batch_size integer DEFAULT 1000)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF p_batch_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tamanho de lote inválido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT d.id,
      CASE WHEN d.state IN ('delivered','cancelled') THEN 'delivered_or_cancelled_180d'
           ELSE 'failed_or_uncertain_365d' END AS reason
    FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries d
    WHERE ((d.state IN ('delivered','cancelled') AND d.updated_at < clock_timestamp()-interval '180 days')
       OR (d.state IN ('failed','uncertain') AND d.updated_at < clock_timestamp()-interval '365 days'))
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries child WHERE child.supersedes_delivery_id=d.id)
    ORDER BY d.updated_at,d.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT p_batch_size
  ), archived AS (
    INSERT INTO public.sicoob_approval_delivery_archive(delivery_id,delivery_record,retention_reason)
    SELECT d.id,to_jsonb(d),c.reason FROM candidates c
    JOIN public.sicoob_approval_deliveries d ON d.id=c.id
    ON CONFLICT(delivery_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING delivery_id
  )
  DELETE FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries d USING archived a WHERE d.id=a.delivery_id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_rls_coverage()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_database_auditor();
  RETURN (WITH t AS (
    SELECT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname AS table_name, c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled
    FROM pg_class c
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND n.nspname = 'public'
  ),
  cols AS (
    SELECT table_schema, table_name,
      bool_or(column_name IN ('seller_id','user_id','owner_id','created_by','assigned_to')) AS is_owned
    FROM information_schema.columns
    WHERE table_schema = 'public'
    GROUP BY table_schema, table_name
  ),
  pol AS (
    SELECT schemaname AS schema, tablename AS table_name,
      bool_or(cmd IN ('SELECT','ALL')) AS has_select,
      bool_or(cmd IN ('INSERT','ALL')) AS has_insert,
      bool_or(cmd IN ('UPDATE','ALL')) AS has_update,
      bool_or(cmd IN ('DELETE','ALL')) AS has_delete,
      count(*)::int AS policy_count
    FROM pg_policies
    WHERE schemaname = 'public'
    GROUP BY schemaname, tablename
  ),
  base AS (
    SELECT t.table_name, t.rls_enabled,
      COALESCE(pol.has_select,false) AS has_select,
      COALESCE(pol.has_insert,false) AS has_insert,
      COALESCE(pol.has_update,false) AS has_update,
      COALESCE(pol.has_delete,false) AS has_delete,
      COALESCE(pol.policy_count,0) AS policy_count
    FROM t
    JOIN cols ON cols.table_schema = t.schema AND cols.table_name = t.table_name AND cols.is_owned
    LEFT JOIN pol ON pol.schema = t.schema AND pol.table_name = t.table_name
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'table', table_name,
    'rls_enabled', rls_enabled,
    'policy_count', policy_count,
    'has_select', has_select,
    'has_insert', has_insert,
    'has_update', has_update,
    'has_delete', has_delete,
    'missing_ops', (
      ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY[
        CASE WHEN NOT has_select THEN 'SELECT' END,
        CASE WHEN NOT has_insert THEN 'INSERT' END,
        CASE WHEN NOT has_update THEN 'UPDATE' END,
        CASE WHEN NOT has_delete THEN 'DELETE' END
      ], NULL)
    ),
    'severity', CASE
      WHEN NOT rls_enabled THEN 'critical'
      WHEN NOT has_select THEN 'high'
      WHEN (NOT has_insert) OR (NOT has_update) OR (NOT has_delete) THEN 'medium'
      ELSE 'ok'
    END
  ) ORDER BY
    (NOT rls_enabled) DESC,
    (NOT has_select) DESC,
    table_name
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM base
  WHERE NOT rls_enabled
     OR NOT has_select OR NOT has_insert OR NOT has_update OR NOT has_delete);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_rls_matrix()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_database_auditor();

  WITH crit_tables AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.table_name
    FROM information_schema.columns c
    JOIN information_schema.tables t
      ON t.table_schema = c.table_schema AND t.table_name = c.table_name
    WHERE c.table_schema = 'public'
      AND t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
      AND c.column_name IN ('seller_id','user_id','owner_id','created_by','assigned_to')
  ),
  rls AS (
    SELECT n.nspname AS schema, c.relname AS table_name, c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled
    FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
    WHERE c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') AND n.nspname = 'public'
  ),
  ops AS (
    SELECT unnest(ARRAY['SELECT','INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE']) AS op
  ),
  pol_per_op AS (
    -- Expande policies "ALL" para as 4 operações
    SELECT p.tablename, op.op AS cmd,
           p.policyname, p.qual, p.with_check, p.permissive, p.roles
    FROM pg_policies p
    CROSS JOIN ops op
    WHERE p.schemaname = 'public'
      AND (p.cmd = op.op OR p.cmd = 'ALL')
  ),
  agg AS (
    SELECT tablename, cmd,
      jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'name', policyname,
        'qual', COALESCE(qual::text,''),
        'with_check', COALESCE(with_check::text,''),
        'permissive', permissive,
        'roles', roles
      ) ORDER BY policyname) AS policies,
      string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(qual::text,''), ' || ' ORDER BY COALESCE(qual::text,'')) AS quals_concat
    FROM pol_per_op
    GROUP BY tablename, cmd
  ),
  matrix AS (
    SELECT
      t.table_name,
      r.rls_enabled,
      o.op,
      a.policies,
      a.quals_concat,
      (a.policies IS NULL) AS missing
    FROM crit_tables t
    LEFT JOIN rls r ON r.table_name = t.table_name
    CROSS JOIN ops o
    LEFT JOIN agg a ON a.tablename = t.table_name AND a.cmd = o.op
  ),
  -- Detecta divergência: o predicado de SELECT é diferente do de UPDATE/DELETE
  divergence AS (
    SELECT m.table_name,
      max(m.quals_concat) FILTER (WHERE m.op = 'SELECT') AS sel_q,
      max(m.quals_concat) FILTER (WHERE m.op = 'UPDATE') AS upd_q,
      max(m.quals_concat) FILTER (WHERE m.op = 'DELETE') AS del_q
    FROM matrix m
    GROUP BY m.table_name
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'table', m.table_name,
    'rls_enabled', COALESCE(m.rls_enabled,false),
    'operation', m.op,
    'missing', m.missing,
    'policy_count', COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(m.policies),0),
    'policies', COALESCE(m.policies,'[]'::jsonb),
    'criterion_diverges',
      CASE
        WHEN m.op = 'UPDATE' AND d.sel_q IS NOT NULL AND d.upd_q IS NOT NULL AND d.sel_q <> d.upd_q THEN true
        WHEN m.op = 'DELETE' AND d.sel_q IS NOT NULL AND d.del_q IS NOT NULL AND d.sel_q <> d.del_q THEN true
        ELSE false
      END,
    'severity',
      CASE
        WHEN NOT COALESCE(m.rls_enabled,false) THEN 'critical'
        WHEN m.missing AND m.op = 'SELECT' THEN 'high'
        WHEN m.missing THEN 'medium'
        WHEN ((m.op = 'UPDATE' AND d.sel_q IS NOT NULL AND d.upd_q IS NOT NULL AND d.sel_q <> d.upd_q)
           OR (m.op = 'DELETE' AND d.sel_q IS NOT NULL AND d.del_q IS NOT NULL AND d.sel_q <> d.del_q)) THEN 'review'
        ELSE 'ok'
      END
  ) ORDER BY m.table_name,
       CASE m.op WHEN 'SELECT' THEN 1 WHEN 'INSERT' THEN 2 WHEN 'UPDATE' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
  ), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_result
  FROM matrix m
  LEFT JOIN divergence d ON d.table_name = m.table_name;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_security_definer_acl()
 RETURNS TABLE(function_name text, arguments text, problem text, granted_to text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH reviewed AS (
    SELECT to_regprocedure(signature)::oid AS oid
      FROM unnest(ARRAY[
        'public.get_sicoob_invitation(text)'
      ]) AS signatures(signature)
  ), defs AS (
    SELECT
      p.oid,
      p.proname::text AS name,
      pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) AS args,
      p.prorettype = 'pg_catalog.trigger'::regtype AS is_trigger,
      EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reviewed r WHERE r.oid = p.oid) AS anon_intent,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM aclexplode(COALESCE(p.proacl, acldefault('f', p.proowner))) a
         WHERE a.grantee = 0
           AND a.privilege_type = 'EXECUTE'
      ) AS public_execute
    FROM pg_proc p
    JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace
    WHERE n.nspname = 'public'
      AND p.prosecdef
  )
  SELECT name, args, 'PUBLIC tem EXECUTE'::text, 'PUBLIC'::text
    FROM defs
   WHERE public_execute
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, args, 'anon tem EXECUTE fora das assinaturas revisadas'::text, 'anon'::text
    FROM defs
   WHERE NOT anon_intent
     AND has_function_privilege('anon', oid, 'EXECUTE')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT name, args, 'authenticated tem EXECUTE em função de trigger'::text, 'authenticated'::text
    FROM defs
   WHERE is_trigger
     AND has_function_privilege('authenticated', oid, 'EXECUTE')
  ORDER BY 1, 2, 4;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_sicoob_order_status_change()

DECLARE

BEGIN
    IF (OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status) THEN

            jsonb_build_object('status', NEW.status),
            now()
        );
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_block_extreme_offenders()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _row record;
  _admin record;
  _blocked_count int := 0;
  _system_uid uuid;
  _expires timestamptz := now() + interval '6 hours';
BEGIN
  -- created_by precisa de uuid; usa o primeiro admin como ator do sistema
  SELECT user_id INTO _system_uid
  FROM public.user_roles
  WHERE role = 'admin'
  ORDER BY user_id ASC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF _system_uid IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'no_admin_for_system_actor');
  END IF;

  FOR _row IN
    WITH offenders AS (
      SELECT ip_address, count(*) AS cnt
      FROM (
        SELECT ip_address FROM public.login_attempts
          WHERE success = false AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour' AND ip_address IS NOT NULL AND ip_address <> 'unknown'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ip_address FROM public.public_token_failures
          WHERE created_at > now() - interval '1 hour' AND ip_address IS NOT NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ip_address FROM public.bot_detection_log
          WHERE blocked = true AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour' AND ip_address IS NOT NULL
      ) s
      GROUP BY ip_address
      HAVING count(*) >= 30
    )
    SELECT o.ip_address, o.cnt
    FROM offenders o
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.ip_access_control iac
      WHERE iac.ip_address = o.ip_address
        AND iac.list_type = 'block'
        AND (iac.expires_at IS NULL OR iac.expires_at > now())
    )
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.ip_access_control (
      ip_address, list_type, reason, expires_at, created_by
    ) VALUES (
      _row.ip_address,
      'block',
      format('Auto-bloqueio: %s ofensas em 1h', _row.cnt),
      _expires,
      _system_uid
    );

    INSERT INTO public.admin_audit_log (
      user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, ip_address, details
    ) VALUES (
      _system_uid,
      'auto_ip_block',
      'ip_access_control',
      _row.ip_address,
      _row.ip_address,
      jsonb_build_object('offense_count', _row.cnt, 'expires_at', _expires, 'window', '1h')
    );

    -- Notifica admins (dedupe por IP em 1h)
    FOR _admin IN SELECT user_id FROM public.user_roles WHERE role = 'admin' LOOP
      IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_notifications
        WHERE user_id = _admin.user_id
          AND category = 'security'
          AND title = '🛡️ IP auto-bloqueado'
          AND metadata->>'ip' = _row.ip_address
          AND created_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
      ) THEN
        INSERT INTO public.workspace_notifications (
          user_id, title, message, type, category, action_url, metadata
        ) VALUES (
          _admin.user_id,
          '🛡️ IP auto-bloqueado',
          format('IP %s bloqueado por 6h após %s ofensas em 1h.', _row.ip_address, _row.cnt),
          'warning',
          'security',
          '/admin/seguranca-acesso',
          jsonb_build_object('ip', _row.ip_address, 'offense_count', _row.cnt, 'expires_at', _expires)
        );
      END IF;
    END LOOP;

    _blocked_count := _blocked_count + 1;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'blocked', _blocked_count, 'ran_at', now());
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_fulfillment_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Se o status não mudou, ok
    IF (OLD.fulfillment_status = NEW.fulfillment_status) THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;

    -- Regras de transição (mesma lógica do frontend para consistência)
    -- pending -> [in_production, cancelled]
    -- in_production -> [in_separation, cancelled]
    -- in_separation -> [in_transit, cancelled]
    -- in_transit -> [delivered, cancelled]
    -- delivered -> [completed, cancelled]
    
    IF (OLD.fulfillment_status = 'pending' AND NEW.fulfillment_status NOT IN ('in_production', 'cancelled')) OR
       (OLD.fulfillment_status = 'in_production' AND NEW.fulfillment_status NOT IN ('in_separation', 'cancelled')) OR
       (OLD.fulfillment_status = 'in_separation' AND NEW.fulfillment_status NOT IN ('in_transit', 'cancelled')) OR
       (OLD.fulfillment_status = 'in_transit' AND NEW.fulfillment_status NOT IN ('delivered', 'cancelled')) OR
       (OLD.fulfillment_status = 'delivered' AND NEW.fulfillment_status NOT IN ('completed', 'cancelled')) OR
       (OLD.fulfillment_status = 'completed') OR
       (OLD.fulfillment_status = 'cancelled') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transição de status de fulfillment inválida: de % para %', OLD.fulfillment_status, NEW.fulfillment_status;
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_rate_limit(_identifier text, _endpoint text, _max_requests integer DEFAULT 60, _window_seconds integer DEFAULT 60, _block_duration_seconds integer DEFAULT 3600)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _row record;
  _now timestamptz := now();
  _window_start timestamptz := _now - make_interval(secs => _window_seconds);
BEGIN
  -- Atomic upsert with row lock
  INSERT INTO public.request_rate_limits (identifier, endpoint, request_count, window_start)
  VALUES (_identifier, _endpoint, 1, _now)
  ON CONFLICT (identifier, endpoint) DO UPDATE
  SET 
    request_count = CASE 
      WHEN request_rate_limits.window_start < _window_start THEN 1
      ELSE request_rate_limits.request_count + 1
    END,
    window_start = CASE
      WHEN request_rate_limits.window_start < _window_start THEN _now
      ELSE request_rate_limits.window_start
    END,
    blocked_until = CASE
      WHEN request_rate_limits.blocked_until IS NOT NULL AND request_rate_limits.blocked_until > _now 
        THEN request_rate_limits.blocked_until
      WHEN request_rate_limits.window_start >= _window_start AND request_rate_limits.request_count + 1 > _max_requests
        THEN _now + make_interval(secs => _block_duration_seconds)
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    updated_at = _now
  RETURNING * INTO _row;

  -- Currently blocked?
  IF _row.blocked_until IS NOT NULL AND _row.blocked_until > _now THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'allowed', false,
      'reason', 'blocked',
      'blocked_until', _row.blocked_until,
      'retry_after_seconds', EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (_row.blocked_until - _now))::integer
    );
  END IF;

  -- Exceeded limit in current window?
  IF _row.request_count > _max_requests THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'allowed', false,
      'reason', 'rate_exceeded',
      'count', _row.request_count,
      'limit', _max_requests,
      'retry_after_seconds', _block_duration_seconds
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'allowed', true,
    'count', _row.request_count,
    'limit', _max_requests,
    'remaining', GREATEST(_max_requests - _row.request_count, 0)
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_sicoob_approval_delivery(p_request_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF sicoob_approval_deliveries
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_id uuid; v_changed record;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.sicoob_approval_deliveries SET state='uncertain',last_error_code='lease_expired',updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE state='sending' AND lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
    AND (p_request_id IS NULL OR request_id=p_request_id);

  UPDATE public.sicoob_approval_deliveries d SET
    state=CASE WHEN d.attempts=0 THEN 'cancelled' ELSE 'uncertain' END,
    last_error_code=CASE WHEN d.attempts=0 THEN 'source_changed' ELSE 'destination_changed_after_attempt' END,
    updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE d.state IN ('pending','retry') AND (p_request_id IS NULL OR d.request_id=p_request_id)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.pa_notification_settings s
      JOIN public.sicoob_approval_requests r ON r.id=d.request_id
      JOIN public.sicoob_orders o ON o.id=r.order_id
      WHERE s.id=d.setting_id AND s.pa_id=o.pa_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE
        AND s.channel=d.channel AND r.status='pending'
        AND d.destination=CASE s.channel WHEN 'slack' THEN COALESCE(s.webhook_url,'') ELSE COALESCE(s.recipient_email,'') END
    );

  FOR v_changed IN
    SELECT DISTINCT d.request_id,d.event_kind
    FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries d
    JOIN public.sicoob_approval_requests r ON r.id=d.request_id AND r.status='pending'
    WHERE d.state='cancelled' AND d.attempts=0 AND d.last_error_code='source_changed'
      AND (p_request_id IS NULL OR d.request_id=p_request_id)
  LOOP
    PERFORM public.enqueue_sicoob_approval_event(v_changed.request_id,v_changed.event_kind);
  END LOOP;

  SELECT d.id INTO v_id FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries d
  WHERE d.state IN ('pending','retry') AND d.available_at<=clock_timestamp() AND d.attempts<5
    AND (p_request_id IS NULL OR d.request_id=p_request_id)
  ORDER BY d.available_at,d.id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1;
  IF v_id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY UPDATE public.sicoob_approval_deliveries SET state='sending',attempts=attempts+1,
    lease_token=gen_random_uuid(),lease_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '60 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id=v_id RETURNING *;
END;
$function$

BEGIN
  IF auth.role() <> 'service_role' THEN

  WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT id FROM public.export_jobs
    WHERE status IN ('pending', 'failed')

    ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

  )

  SET status = 'processing', attempts = COALESCE(job.attempts, 0) + 1,

  FROM candidates
  WHERE job.id = candidates.id
  RETURNING job.*;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_quote_version_atomic(p_source_quote_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_source public.quotes%ROWTYPE;
  v_source_item public.quote_items%ROWTYPE;
  v_root_id uuid;
  v_new_quote_id uuid;
  v_new_item_id uuid;
  v_next_version integer;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '42501',
      MESSAGE = 'Autenticação necessária para criar uma versão de orçamento.';
  END IF;

  SELECT *
  INTO v_source
  FROM public.quotes
  WHERE id = p_source_quote_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND OR v_source.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR coalesce(v_source.is_active, true) = false THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = 'P0002', MESSAGE = 'Orçamento de origem não encontrado ou inativo.';
  END IF;

  IF v_source.seller_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_id
    AND NOT (
      public.can_manage_quotes(v_actor_id)
      AND (
        EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
          WHERE ur.user_id = v_actor_id AND ur.role::text IN ('admin', 'dev')
        )
        OR v_source.organization_id IS NULL
        OR v_source.organization_id IN (SELECT public.get_user_org_ids(v_actor_id))
      )
    ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '42501',
      MESSAGE = 'Você não possui permissão para versionar este orçamento.';
  END IF;

  v_root_id := coalesce(v_source.parent_quote_id, v_source.id);

  -- Serializa todas as versões da mesma família, mesmo quando duas abas usam
  -- versões-filhas diferentes como origem.
  PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(v_root_id::text, 0));

  SELECT *
  INTO v_source
  FROM public.quotes
  WHERE id = p_source_quote_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT v_source.is_latest_version THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '40001',
      MESSAGE = 'Uma versão mais recente já foi criada. Atualize a página antes de continuar.';
  END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(max(version), 0) + 1
  INTO v_next_version
  FROM public.quotes
  WHERE id = v_root_id OR parent_quote_id = v_root_id;

  UPDATE public.quotes
  SET is_latest_version = false
  WHERE (id = v_root_id OR parent_quote_id = v_root_id)
    AND is_latest_version;

  -- Copia apenas os dados comerciais e de contexto. Decisões, integrações e
  -- respostas do cliente pertencem à versão anterior e devem ser revalidadas.
  INSERT INTO public.quotes (
    client_cnpj,
    client_company,
    client_email,
    client_id,
    client_name,
    client_phone,
    delivery_time,
    discount_amount,
    discount_percent,
    internal_notes,
    is_active,
    is_latest_version,
    negotiation_markup_percent,
    notes,
    organization_id,
    pa_id,
    parent_quote_id,
    payment_terms,
    real_discount_percent,
    real_subtotal,
    seller_id,
    shipping_cost,
    shipping_type,
    singular_id,
    status,
    subtotal,
    suggested_modifications,
    tags,
    total,
    total_cost,
    valid_until,
    version
  ) VALUES (
    v_source.client_cnpj,
    v_source.client_company,
    v_source.client_email,
    v_source.client_id,
    v_source.client_name,
    v_source.client_phone,
    v_source.delivery_time,
    v_source.discount_amount,
    v_source.discount_percent,
    v_source.internal_notes,
    true,
    true,
    v_source.negotiation_markup_percent,
    v_source.notes,
    v_source.organization_id,
    v_source.pa_id,
    v_root_id,
    v_source.payment_terms,
    v_source.real_discount_percent,
    v_source.real_subtotal,
    v_source.seller_id,
    v_source.shipping_cost,
    v_source.shipping_type,
    v_source.singular_id,
    'draft',
    v_source.subtotal,
    NULL,
    v_source.tags,
    v_source.total,
    v_source.total_cost,
    v_source.valid_until,
    v_next_version
  )
  RETURNING id INTO v_new_quote_id;

  FOR v_source_item IN
    SELECT *
    FROM public.quote_items
    WHERE quote_id = v_source.id
    ORDER BY coalesce(display_order, sort_order, 0), created_at, id
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO public.quote_items (
      quote_id,
      color_hex,
      color_name,
      display_order,
      gender,
      kit_group_id,
      kit_name,
      notes,
      price_confirmed_at,
      product_id,
      product_image_url,
      product_name,
      product_sku,
      quantity,
      size_code,
      sort_order,
      subtotal,
      source_variant_id,
      source_variant_sku,
      catalog_checked_at,
      unit_cost,
      unit_price
    ) VALUES (
      v_new_quote_id,
      v_source_item.color_hex,
      v_source_item.color_name,
      v_source_item.display_order,
      v_source_item.gender,
      v_source_item.kit_group_id,
      v_source_item.kit_name,
      v_source_item.notes,
      NULL,
      v_source_item.product_id,
      v_source_item.product_image_url,
      v_source_item.product_name,
      v_source_item.product_sku,
      v_source_item.quantity,
      v_source_item.size_code,
      v_source_item.sort_order,
      v_source_item.subtotal,
      v_source_item.source_variant_id,
      v_source_item.source_variant_sku,
      v_source_item.catalog_checked_at,
      v_source_item.unit_cost,
      v_source_item.unit_price
    )
    RETURNING id INTO v_new_item_id;

    INSERT INTO public.quote_item_personalizations (
      quote_item_id,
      area_cm2,
      colors_count,
      height_cm,
      notes,
      personalized_quantity,
      positions_count,
      setup_cost,
      technique_id,
      technique_name,
      total_cost,
      unit_cost,
      width_cm
    )
    SELECT
      v_new_item_id,
      area_cm2,
      colors_count,
      height_cm,
      notes,
      personalized_quantity,
      positions_count,
      setup_cost,
      technique_id,
      technique_name,
      total_cost,
      unit_cost,
      width_cm
    FROM public.quote_item_personalizations
    WHERE quote_item_id = v_source_item.id;
  END LOOP;

  INSERT INTO public.quote_history (
    quote_id,
    user_id,
    action,
    description,
    metadata
  ) VALUES (
    v_new_quote_id,
    v_actor_id,
    'version_created',
    format('Versão %s criada a partir de %s (v%s).', v_next_version, v_source.quote_number, v_source.version),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'source_quote_id', v_source.id,
      'source_quote_number', v_source.quote_number,
      'source_version', v_source.version,
      'version', v_next_version
    )
  );

  RETURN v_new_quote_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dispatch_sicoob_order_consolidation(p_consolidation_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_group public.order_consolidations%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_group FROM public.order_consolidations
   WHERE id = p_consolidation_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_group.status <> 'pending_seller' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001', MESSAGE = 'A consolidação mudou; atualize a página.';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.sicoob_actor_can_manage_consolidation(v_actor_id, v_group.singular_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501', MESSAGE = 'Usuário fora do escopo da consolidação.';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.sicoob_delivery_destinations d
      LEFT JOIN public.postos_atendimento pa ON pa.id = d.pa_id
     WHERE d.consolidation_id = p_consolidation_id
       AND (
         pa.id IS NULL
         OR pa.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM true
         OR NULLIF(trim(pa.nome), '') IS NULL
         OR NULLIF(trim(pa.codigo), '') IS NULL
         OR NULLIF(trim(pa.endereco), '') IS NULL
         OR NULLIF(trim(pa.cidade), '') IS NULL
         OR NULLIF(trim(pa.uf), '') IS NULL
         OR d.destination_name IS DISTINCT FROM pa.nome
         OR d.address_snapshot ->> 'codigo' IS DISTINCT FROM pa.codigo
         OR d.address_snapshot ->> 'endereco' IS DISTINCT FROM pa.endereco
         OR d.address_snapshot ->> 'cidade' IS DISTINCT FROM pa.cidade
         OR d.address_snapshot ->> 'uf' IS DISTINCT FROM pa.uf
       )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514', MESSAGE = 'Um destino mudou, está inativo ou incompleto; atualize a distribuição antes do despacho.';
  END IF;
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT oi.id
    FROM public.order_consolidation_orders co
    JOIN public.sicoob_order_items oi ON oi.order_id = co.order_id
    LEFT JOIN (
      SELECT a.order_item_id, sum(a.quantity) AS allocated_quantity
      FROM public.sicoob_delivery_allocations a
      JOIN public.sicoob_delivery_destinations d ON d.id = a.destination_id
      WHERE d.consolidation_id = p_consolidation_id
      GROUP BY a.order_item_id
    ) allocated ON allocated.order_item_id = oi.id
    WHERE co.consolidation_id = p_consolidation_id
      AND COALESCE(allocated.allocated_quantity, 0) <> oi.quantity
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '23514', MESSAGE = 'Todos os itens precisam de um destino antes do despacho.';
  END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('app.sicoob_consolidation_operation', 'dispatch', true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.sicoob_order_status_comment', 'Despachado no lote consolidado ' || p_consolidation_id::text || '.', true);
  UPDATE public.sicoob_orders o
     SET status = 'logistic', updated_at = now()
    FROM public.order_consolidation_orders co
   WHERE co.consolidation_id = p_consolidation_id
     AND co.order_id = o.id
     AND o.status = 'confirmed';
  IF NOT FOUND OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.order_consolidation_orders co
      JOIN public.sicoob_orders o ON o.id = co.order_id
     WHERE co.consolidation_id = p_consolidation_id
       AND o.status <> 'logistic'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '40001', MESSAGE = 'Um pedido do lote mudou; atualize a página.';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.order_consolidations SET status = 'sent', updated_at = now()
   WHERE id = p_consolidation_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.e2e_cleanup_check_rate_limit(p_key text, p_max integer, p_window_seconds integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(allowed boolean, current_count integer, reset_in_seconds integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_now TIMESTAMPTZ := now();
  v_count INT;
  v_window_start TIMESTAMPTZ;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.e2e_cleanup_rate_limit AS r (key, count, window_start, updated_at)
  VALUES (p_key, 1, v_now, v_now)
  ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE
    SET count = CASE
          WHEN r.window_start < v_now - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds) THEN 1
          ELSE r.count + 1
        END,
        window_start = CASE
          WHEN r.window_start < v_now - make_interval(secs => p_window_seconds) THEN v_now
          ELSE r.window_start
        END,
        updated_at = v_now
  RETURNING r.count, r.window_start INTO v_count, v_window_start;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT
    (v_count <= p_max) AS allowed,
    v_count AS current_count,
    GREATEST(0, p_window_seconds - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v_now - v_window_start))::INT) AS reset_in_seconds;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enqueue_sicoob_approval_event(p_request_id uuid, p_event_kind text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF p_event_kind IS NULL OR p_event_kind NOT IN ('request_created','escalated_to_board') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Evento de aprovação inválido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.sicoob_approval_deliveries(
    request_id,setting_id,channel,destination,payload,event_kind,generation,supersedes_delivery_id
  )
  SELECT r.id,s.id,s.channel,
    CASE s.channel WHEN 'slack' THEN COALESCE(s.webhook_url,'') ELSE COALESCE(s.recipient_email,'') END,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'requester_name',COALESCE(p.full_name,'Solicitante'),'amount',r.amount_at_request,
      'reason',COALESCE(r.request_reason,''),'order_id',r.order_id,'event_kind',p_event_kind
    ),p_event_kind,COALESCE(previous.generation,0)+1,previous.id
  FROM public.sicoob_approval_requests r
  JOIN public.sicoob_orders o ON o.id=r.order_id
  JOIN public.pa_notification_settings s ON s.pa_id=o.pa_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT full_name FROM public.profiles WHERE user_id=r.requester_id OR id=r.requester_id
    ORDER BY (user_id=r.requester_id) DESC NULLS LAST,id LIMIT 1
  ) p ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT d.id,d.generation,d.state,d.attempts,d.last_error_code
    FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries d
    WHERE d.request_id=r.id AND d.event_kind=p_event_kind AND d.channel=s.channel
    ORDER BY d.generation DESC LIMIT 1
  ) previous ON true
  WHERE r.id=p_request_id AND r.status='pending'
    AND (previous.id IS NULL OR (
      previous.state='cancelled' AND previous.attempts=0 AND previous.last_error_code='source_changed'
    ))
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries d
      WHERE d.request_id=r.id AND d.event_kind=p_event_kind AND d.channel=s.channel
        AND d.destination=CASE s.channel WHEN 'slack' THEN COALESCE(s.webhook_url,'') ELSE COALESCE(s.recipient_email,'') END
        AND d.state<>'cancelled'
    )
  ON CONFLICT(request_id,event_kind,channel,generation) DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_count=ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_sicoob_approval_delivery(p_id uuid, p_lease_token uuid, p_outcome text, p_error_code text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_provider_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p_outcome IS NULL OR p_outcome NOT IN ('delivered','retry','uncertain','failed')
    OR (p_error_code IS NOT NULL AND p_error_code !~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,80}$')
    OR length(p_provider_id)>200
    OR (p_outcome='delivered' AND (p_provider_id IS NULL OR btrim(p_provider_id)=''))
    OR (p_outcome IN ('retry','uncertain','failed') AND (p_error_code IS NULL OR btrim(p_error_code)='')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Resultado de entrega inválido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  UPDATE public.sicoob_approval_deliveries SET
    state=CASE WHEN p_outcome='retry' AND attempts>=5 THEN 'failed' ELSE p_outcome END,
    available_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs => LEAST(900,30*power(2,attempts-1))::integer),
    last_error_code=p_error_code, provider_id=p_provider_id, updated_at=clock_timestamp(),
    delivered_at=CASE WHEN p_outcome='delivered' THEN clock_timestamp() END,
    lease_expires_at=NULL, lease_token=NULL
  WHERE id=p_id AND state='sending' AND lease_token=p_lease_token AND lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp();
  RETURN FOUND;
END;
$function$

    ELSE NULLIF(to_jsonb(OLD) ->> 'order_id', '')::uuid

  v_new_order_id uuid := CASE

    PERFORM 1
      FROM public.sicoob_orders o
     WHERE o.id IN (v_old_order_id, v_new_order_id)

     WHERE o.id IN (v_old_order_id, v_new_order_id)

  ) THEN

  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_app_health_summary(_minutes integer DEFAULT 60)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_since timestamptz := now() - make_interval(mins => GREATEST(1, LEAST(_minutes, 1440)));
  v_kpis jsonb;
  v_routes jsonb;
  v_webhooks jsonb;
  v_edges jsonb;
BEGIN
  -- Authorization: admin or dev only
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'dev'::app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- ======================================================================
  -- 1) KPIs globais (req/min, %4xx, %5xx, p95 ms)
  -- ======================================================================
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total', COUNT(*),
    'req_per_min', ROUND((COUNT(*)::numeric / GREATEST(1, _minutes))::numeric, 2),
    'pct_4xx', CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
                    ELSE ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE http_status BETWEEN 400 AND 499))::numeric * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END,
    'pct_5xx', CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0
                    ELSE ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE http_status >= 500))::numeric * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END,
    'p95_ms', COALESCE(percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms), 0),
    'p99_ms', COALESCE(percentile_disc(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms), 0),
    'window_minutes', _minutes,
    'since', v_since
  )
  INTO v_kpis
  FROM public.webhook_delivery_metrics
  WHERE occurred_at >= v_since;

  -- ======================================================================
  -- 2) Top rotas por erro (4xx + 5xx), com breakdown
  -- ======================================================================
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(r)), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_routes
  FROM (
    SELECT
      endpoint,
      direction,
      COUNT(*) AS total,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE http_status BETWEEN 400 AND 499) AS count_4xx,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE http_status >= 500) AS count_5xx,
      ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE http_status >= 400))::numeric * 100.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS error_rate_pct,
      MAX(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE http_status >= 400) AS last_error_at
    FROM public.webhook_delivery_metrics
    WHERE occurred_at >= v_since
      AND endpoint IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY endpoint, direction
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE http_status >= 400) > 0
    ORDER BY (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE http_status >= 400)) DESC
    LIMIT 20
  ) r;

  -- ======================================================================
  -- 3) Webhooks por source × direction (taxa de falha)
  -- ======================================================================
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(r)), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_webhooks
  FROM (
    SELECT
      source,
      direction,
      COUNT(*) AS total,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS failures,
      ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success))::numeric * 100.0
            / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS failure_rate_pct,
      COALESCE(percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms), 0) AS p95_ms,
      MAX(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS last_failure_at
    FROM public.webhook_delivery_metrics
    WHERE occurred_at >= v_since
    GROUP BY source, direction
    ORDER BY failures DESC, total DESC
    LIMIT 30
  ) r;

  -- ======================================================================
  -- 4) Edge functions por p95 latency (proxy: source agrupado)
  -- ======================================================================
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(r)), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_edges
  FROM (
    SELECT
      source AS edge_function,
      COUNT(*) AS total,
      COALESCE(percentile_disc(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms), 0) AS p50_ms,
      COALESCE(percentile_disc(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms), 0) AS p95_ms,
      COALESCE(percentile_disc(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms), 0) AS p99_ms,
      ROUND(AVG(duration_ms)::numeric, 0) AS avg_ms,
      MAX(duration_ms) AS max_ms
    FROM public.webhook_delivery_metrics
    WHERE occurred_at >= v_since
    GROUP BY source
    ORDER BY p95_ms DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 30
  ) r;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'kpis', v_kpis,
    'top_routes_by_error', v_routes,
    'webhooks_by_source', v_webhooks,
    'edges_by_latency', v_edges
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_auto_test_job_status(_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(run_started_at timestamp with time zone, run_ended_at timestamp with time zone, duration_ms integer, total_tested integer, ok_count integer, fail_count integer, retried_count integer, avg_latency_ms integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: admin role required';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT
      cth.tested_at,
      cth.success,
      cth.latency_ms,
      cth.attempts,
      date_trunc('minute', cth.tested_at) AS bucket
    FROM public.connection_test_history cth
    WHERE cth.triggered_by = 'cron'
      AND cth.tested_at > now() - interval '7 days'
  ),
  runs AS (
    SELECT
      o.bucket,
      MIN(o.tested_at) AS run_started_at,
      MAX(o.tested_at) AS run_ended_at,
      GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(o.tested_at) - MIN(o.tested_at))) * 1000, 0)::int AS duration_ms,
      COUNT(*)::int AS total_tested,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.success)::int AS ok_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT o.success)::int AS fail_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.attempts > 1)::int AS retried_count,
      COALESCE(AVG(o.latency_ms) FILTER (WHERE o.latency_ms IS NOT NULL), 0)::int AS avg_latency_ms
    FROM ordered o
    GROUP BY o.bucket
  )
  SELECT
    r.run_started_at,
    r.run_ended_at,
    r.duration_ms,
    r.total_tested,
    r.ok_count,
    r.fail_count,
    r.retried_count,
    r.avg_latency_ms
  FROM runs r
  ORDER BY r.run_started_at DESC
  LIMIT GREATEST(1, LEAST(_limit, 100));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_bundle_suggestions(_product_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_id text, product_name text, product_image_url text, cooccurrence_count bigint, frequency_percent numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH anchor_quotes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT quote_id
    FROM public.quote_items
    WHERE product_id = _product_id
  ),
  total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric AS n FROM anchor_quotes
  ),
  cooc AS (
    SELECT
      qi.product_id,
      MAX(qi.product_name) AS product_name,
      MAX(qi.product_image_url) AS product_image_url,
      COUNT(DISTINCT qi.quote_id) AS cnt
    FROM public.quote_items qi
    JOIN anchor_quotes aq ON aq.quote_id = qi.quote_id
    WHERE qi.product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND qi.product_id <> _product_id
    GROUP BY qi.product_id
  )
  SELECT
    c.product_id,
    c.product_name,
    c.product_image_url,
    c.cnt AS cooccurrence_count,
    ROUND((c.cnt::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT n FROM total), 0)) * 100, 1) AS frequency_percent
  FROM cooc c, total
  WHERE total.n >= 3
    AND (c.cnt::numeric / NULLIF(total.n, 0)) >= 0.30
  ORDER BY c.cnt DESC
  LIMIT 5;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_client_seasonality(_client_id text, _months integer DEFAULT 24)
 RETURNS TABLE(year integer, month integer, quotes_count bigint, total_revenue numeric, avg_ticket numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.created_at)::int AS year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM q.created_at)::int AS month,
    COUNT(*)::bigint AS quotes_count,
    COALESCE(SUM(q.total), 0)::numeric AS total_revenue,
    COALESCE(AVG(q.total), 0)::numeric AS avg_ticket
  FROM public.quotes q
  WHERE q.client_id = _client_id
    AND q.status IN ('sent','viewed','approved','converted','pending_approval')
    AND q.created_at >= now() - (GREATEST(_months, 1) || ' months')::interval
    AND (
      q.seller_id = auth.uid()
      OR has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role)
      OR has_role(auth.uid(), 'manager'::app_role)
    )
  GROUP BY 1, 2
  ORDER BY 1, 2;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_client_top_products(_client_id text, _limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_id text, product_name text, product_image_url text, total_quantity bigint, occurrences bigint, total_revenue numeric, avg_unit_price numeric, last_quoted_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql

AS $function$
  SELECT
    qi.product_id,
    qi.product_name,
    MAX(qi.product_image_url) AS product_image_url,
    SUM(qi.quantity)::bigint AS total_quantity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT qi.quote_id)::bigint AS occurrences,
    SUM(COALESCE(qi.subtotal, qi.quantity * qi.unit_price))::numeric AS total_revenue,

    MAX(q.created_at) AS last_quoted_at

      q.seller_id = auth.uid()
      OR has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role)
      OR has_role(auth.uid(), 'manager'::app_role)
    )
  GROUP BY qi.product_id, qi.product_name
  ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, occurrences DESC
  LIMIT GREATEST(_limit, 1);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_collections_weekly_count(_weeks integer DEFAULT 8)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_industry_benchmark_stats(_company_ids text[], _days integer DEFAULT 180)
 RETURNS TABLE(total_clients_sampled bigint, avg_ltv numeric, avg_ticket numeric, avg_quotes_per_client numeric, avg_items_per_quote numeric, top_product_name text, total_revenue numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH filtered_quotes AS (
    SELECT q.id, q.client_id, q.total
    FROM public.quotes q
    WHERE q.client_id = ANY(_company_ids)
      AND q.status IN ('sent','viewed','approved','converted','pending_approval')
      AND q.created_at >= now() - (GREATEST(_days, 1) || ' days')::interval
      AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
  ),
  per_client AS (
    SELECT
      client_id,
      SUM(total)::numeric AS client_ltv,
      COUNT(*)::numeric AS client_quote_count,
      AVG(total)::numeric AS client_avg_ticket
    FROM filtered_quotes
    GROUP BY client_id
  ),
  items_per_quote AS (
    SELECT fq.id, COUNT(qi.id)::numeric AS item_count
    FROM filtered_quotes fq
    LEFT JOIN public.quote_items qi ON qi.quote_id = fq.id
    GROUP BY fq.id
  ),
  top_product AS (
    SELECT qi.product_name, SUM(qi.quantity) AS qty
    FROM public.quote_items qi
    JOIN filtered_quotes fq ON fq.id = qi.quote_id
    GROUP BY qi.product_name
    ORDER BY qty DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM per_client) AS total_clients_sampled,
    COALESCE((SELECT AVG(client_ltv) FROM per_client), 0)::numeric AS avg_ltv,
    COALESCE((SELECT AVG(client_avg_ticket) FROM per_client), 0)::numeric AS avg_ticket,
    COALESCE((SELECT AVG(client_quote_count) FROM per_client), 0)::numeric AS avg_quotes_per_client,
    COALESCE((SELECT AVG(item_count) FROM items_per_quote), 0)::numeric AS avg_items_per_quote,
    (SELECT product_name FROM top_product) AS top_product_name,
    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(client_ltv) FROM per_client), 0)::numeric AS total_revenue;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_industry_seasonality(_company_ids text[], _months integer DEFAULT 24)
 RETURNS TABLE(year integer, month integer, avg_quotes_per_company numeric, avg_revenue_per_company numeric, companies_active bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH per_client_month AS (
    SELECT
      q.client_id,
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.created_at)::int AS y,
      EXTRACT(MONTH FROM q.created_at)::int AS m,
      COUNT(*)::numeric AS qc,
      COALESCE(SUM(q.total), 0)::numeric AS rev
    FROM public.quotes q
    WHERE q.client_id = ANY(_company_ids)
      AND q.status IN ('sent','viewed','approved','converted','pending_approval')
      AND q.created_at >= now() - (GREATEST(_months, 1) || ' months')::interval
      AND auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY q.client_id, 2, 3
  )
  SELECT
    y AS year,
    m AS month,
    AVG(qc)::numeric AS avg_quotes_per_company,
    AVG(rev)::numeric AS avg_revenue_per_company,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_id)::bigint AS companies_active
  FROM per_client_month
  GROUP BY y, m
  ORDER BY y, m;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_platform_failure_metrics(window_minutes integer DEFAULT 60)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  window_start timestamptz := now() - make_interval(mins => COALESCE(window_minutes, 60));
  total_calls bigint;
  total_503 bigint;
  total_cold bigint;
  recent_cold_at timestamptz;
  prev_window_start timestamptz := now() - make_interval(mins => COALESCE(window_minutes, 60) * 2);
  prev_503 bigint;
BEGIN
  SELECT COUNT(*),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_503 = true),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_cold_start = true),
         MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE is_cold_start = true)
    INTO total_calls, total_503, total_cold, recent_cold_at
  FROM public.query_telemetry
  WHERE created_at >= window_start;

  SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_503 = true)
    INTO prev_503
  FROM public.query_telemetry
  WHERE created_at >= prev_window_start AND created_at < window_start;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'window_minutes', window_minutes,
    'total_calls', COALESCE(total_calls, 0),
    'total_503', COALESCE(total_503, 0),
    'total_cold_starts', COALESCE(total_cold, 0),
    'rate_503_pct', CASE WHEN COALESCE(total_calls, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                         ELSE ROUND(total_503::numeric / total_calls::numeric * 100, 2) END,
    'rate_cold_start_pct', CASE WHEN COALESCE(total_calls, 0) = 0 THEN 0
                                ELSE ROUND(total_cold::numeric / total_calls::numeric * 100, 2) END,
    'last_cold_start_at', recent_cold_at,
    'prev_window_503', COALESCE(prev_503, 0),
    'delta_503', COALESCE(total_503, 0) - COALESCE(prev_503, 0)
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_quote_approval(_token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_token_id uuid;
  v_payload jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT t.id, jsonb_build_object(
    'quote_number', q.quote_number,
    'client_name', q.client_name,
    'total', q.total,
    'valid_until', q.valid_until,
    'status', t.status,
    'response', t.response,
    'responded_at', t.responded_at,
    'expires_at', t.expires_at,
    'subtotal', to_jsonb(q)->'subtotal',
    'discount_amount', to_jsonb(q)->'discount_amount',
    'shipping_cost', to_jsonb(q)->'shipping_cost',
    'payment_terms', to_jsonb(q)->'payment_terms',
    'delivery_time', to_jsonb(q)->'delivery_time',
    'notes', to_jsonb(q)->'notes',
    'items', public.quote_approval_content_snapshot(q.id)->'items'
  ) INTO v_token_id, v_payload
  FROM public.quote_approval_tokens t
  JOIN public.quotes q ON q.id::text=t.quote_id AND q.seller_id=t.seller_id
  WHERE t.token=_token AND t.status IN ('active','responded')
    AND (t.expires_at IS NULL OR t.expires_at>statement_timestamp())
    AND q.deleted_at IS NULL AND q.is_latest_version
    AND (q.valid_until IS NULL OR q.valid_until::date>=CURRENT_DATE)
  ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE OF t;

  IF v_token_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NULL;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.quote_approval_tokens
  SET viewed_at = COALESCE(viewed_at, clock_timestamp())
  WHERE id = v_token_id;

  RETURN v_payload;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_sicoob_order_approval_policy(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(policy_id uuid, policy_version text, forbid_self_approval boolean, require_active_membership boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH target AS (
    SELECT id,
           cooperative_id,
           approval_policy_id,
           approval_policy_snapshot
      FROM public.sicoob_orders
     WHERE id = p_order_id
  ), candidates AS (
    -- A fotografia gravada na submissão é a fonte de verdade da decisão.
    SELECT NULLIF(t.approval_policy_snapshot ->> 'policy_id', '')::uuid AS policy_id,
           t.approval_policy_snapshot ->> 'version' AS policy_version,
           COALESCE((t.approval_policy_snapshot ->> 'forbid_self_approval')::boolean, true) AS forbid_self_approval,
           COALESCE((t.approval_policy_snapshot ->> 'require_active_membership')::boolean, true) AS require_active_membership,
           4 AS priority,
           NULL::timestamptz AS effective_from
      FROM target t
     WHERE t.approval_policy_snapshot IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- Compatibilidade com pedidos antigos que guardavam somente a referência.
    SELECT p.id,
           p.version,
           p.forbid_self_approval,
           p.require_active_membership,
           3,
           p.effective_from
      FROM public.sicoob_approval_policies p
      JOIN target t ON p.id = t.approval_policy_id
     WHERE t.approval_policy_snapshot IS NULL

    UNION ALL

    -- Uma política da cooperativa sempre vence uma política global, mesmo que
    -- esta última tenha effective_from mais recente.
    SELECT p.id,
           p.version,
           p.forbid_self_approval,
           p.require_active_membership,
           2,
           p.effective_from
      FROM public.sicoob_approval_policies p
      JOIN target t ON t.approval_policy_id IS NULL
                   AND t.approval_policy_snapshot IS NULL
     WHERE p.cooperative_id = t.cooperative_id
       AND p.is_active
       AND p.effective_from <= now()
       AND (p.effective_until IS NULL OR p.effective_until > now())

    UNION ALL

    SELECT p.id,
           p.version,
           p.forbid_self_approval,
           p.require_active_membership,
           1,
           p.effective_from
      FROM public.sicoob_approval_policies p
      JOIN target t ON t.approval_policy_id IS NULL
                   AND t.approval_policy_snapshot IS NULL
     WHERE p.cooperative_id IS NULL
       AND p.is_active
       AND p.effective_from <= now()
       AND (p.effective_until IS NULL OR p.effective_until > now())

    UNION ALL

    SELECT NULL::uuid,
           'baseline-tecnica-v1'::text,
           true,
           true,
           0,
           NULL::timestamptz
  )
  SELECT policy_id,
         policy_version,
         forbid_self_approval,
         require_active_membership
    FROM candidates
   ORDER BY priority DESC, effective_from DESC NULLS LAST, policy_id
   LIMIT 1;
$function$

BEGIN
  -- Se for service_role (edge functions), permite normalmente
  IF v_role = 'service_role' OR current_user = 'service_role' THEN
    RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
  END IF;

  -- Caso contrário, registra violação e bloqueia
  PERFORM public.record_mcp_access_violation(
    v_actor,
    'unauthorized_direct_write',
    'db_trigger:mcp_api_keys',
    TG_OP,
    COALESCE(NEW.id, OLD.id),
    NULL,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    jsonb_build_object('current_user', current_user, 'role', v_role)
  );

  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Direct writes to mcp_api_keys are not allowed';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_quote_governance_write()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF current_setting('app.quote_governance_write', true) = 'true' THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    IF COALESCE(NEW.status, 'draft') <> 'draft'
       OR NEW.approved_by IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.approved_at IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.approved_pdf_url IS NOT NULL
       OR NEW.rejection_notes IS NOT NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION USING
        ERRCODE = '42501',
        MESSAGE = 'A criação de orçamento deve iniciar como rascunho.';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status
     OR NEW.approved_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_by
     OR NEW.approved_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_at
     OR NEW.approved_pdf_url IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_pdf_url
     OR NEW.rejection_notes IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.rejection_notes
     OR NEW.seller_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.seller_id
     OR NEW.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.organization_id
     OR NEW.pa_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.pa_id
     OR NEW.singular_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.singular_id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '42501',
      MESSAGE = 'Campos de governança do orçamento só podem ser alterados por fluxo autorizado.';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

DECLARE

  ) VALUES (
    _uid, _action, _key_id::text, 'full_scope_granted',

    jsonb_build_object(
      'operation',          _operation,
      'key_id',             _key_id,
      'key_prefix',         _key_prefix,
      'expires_at',         _expires_at,
      'justification',      _justification,
      'verifications', jsonb_build_object(

      ),
      'request_id',         _request_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lookup_request_id(_request_id text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_webhook_events jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'admin'::app_role) OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'dev'::app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  IF _request_id IS NULL OR length(_request_id) < 8 OR length(_request_id) > 128 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_request_id' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(row_to_json(r) ORDER BY r.occurred_at), '[]'::jsonb)
  INTO v_webhook_events
  FROM (
    SELECT
      occurred_at,
      source,
      direction,
      event_type,
      endpoint,
      http_status,
      duration_ms,
      attempt,
      success,
      error_class,
      error_message,
      payload_bytes
    FROM public.webhook_delivery_metrics
    WHERE request_id = _request_id
    ORDER BY occurred_at ASC
    LIMIT 200
  ) r;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'request_id', _request_id,
    'webhook_events', v_webhook_events,
    'event_count', jsonb_array_length(v_webhook_events)
  );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.monitor_sicoob_approval_worker()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'net'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_failed bigint; v_queued bigint; v_oldest_seconds integer; v_pending_old bigint; v_unresolved bigint;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.sicoob_approval_worker_dispatches d SET
    state=CASE WHEN r.timed_out IS TRUE THEN 'timed_out'
      WHEN r.error_msg IS NOT NULL OR r.status_code NOT BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN 'failed'
      ELSE 'succeeded' END,
    status_code=r.status_code,
    error_message=left(COALESCE(r.error_msg,r.content),1000),
    completed_at=COALESCE(r.created,clock_timestamp())
  FROM net._http_response r
  WHERE d.request_id=r.id AND d.state='queued';

  UPDATE public.sicoob_approval_worker_dispatches SET
    state='timed_out',error_message='Resposta do pg_net não observada em dois minutos',completed_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE state='queued' AND requested_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '2 minutes';

  DELETE FROM public.sicoob_approval_worker_dispatches
  WHERE requested_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '30 days';

  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('failed','timed_out')),
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE state='queued'),
         COALESCE(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-(min(requested_at) FILTER (WHERE state='queued'))),0)::integer
  INTO v_failed,v_queued,v_oldest_seconds
  FROM public.sicoob_approval_worker_dispatches
  WHERE requested_at>=clock_timestamp()-interval '24 hours';

  SELECT count(*) INTO v_pending_old FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries
  WHERE state IN ('pending','retry') AND available_at<clock_timestamp()-interval '5 minutes';
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_unresolved FROM public.sicoob_approval_deliveries
  WHERE state IN ('failed','uncertain') AND reconciliation IS NULL;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'failed_24h',v_failed,'queued',v_queued,'oldest_queued_seconds',v_oldest_seconds,
    'deliveries_delayed',v_pending_old,'unresolved_deliveries',v_unresolved,
    'healthy',v_failed=0 AND v_pending_old=0 AND v_unresolved=0
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.normalize_quote_parent_root()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_root_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.parent_quote_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.parent_quote_id = NEW.id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      MESSAGE = 'Uma versão de orçamento não pode ser pai de si mesma.';
  END IF;

  PERFORM 1
  FROM public.quotes
  WHERE id = NEW.parent_quote_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
    SELECT q.id, q.parent_quote_id, ARRAY[q.id] AS path
    FROM public.quotes q
    WHERE q.id = NEW.parent_quote_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_quote_id, ancestry.path || parent.id
    FROM ancestry
    JOIN public.quotes parent ON parent.id = ancestry.parent_quote_id
    WHERE NOT parent.id = ANY(ancestry.path)
  )
  SELECT id
  INTO v_root_id
  FROM ancestry
  WHERE parent_quote_id IS NULL
  ORDER BY cardinality(path) DESC
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_root_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      MESSAGE = 'A versão-pai não possui uma raiz válida.';
  END IF;

  IF NEW.id IS NOT NULL AND v_root_id = NEW.id THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      MESSAGE = 'A relação de versões criaria um ciclo.';
  END IF;

  NEW.parent_quote_id := v_root_id;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_export_queue_v3()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  job RECORD;
BEGIN
  FOR job IN (
    SELECT * FROM public.export_jobs
    WHERE status IN ('pending', 'failed') AND attempts < 3
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  ) LOOP
    BEGIN
      UPDATE public.export_jobs 
      SET status = 'processing', attempts = attempts + 1, updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = job.id;

      -- Auditoria de Exportação (Idempotente)
      INSERT INTO public.audit_log (user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, new_values)
      VALUES (
        job.user_id, 
        'export_batch_process', 
        'export_job', 
        job.id::text, 
        jsonb_build_object(
          'type', job.export_type, 
          'filters', job.filters, 
          'attempt', job.attempts + 1,
          'timestamp', now()
        )
      );

      -- Simulação de conclusão (o processamento real PDF/Excel seria assíncrono)
      UPDATE public.export_jobs 
      SET status = 'completed', updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = job.id;

    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      UPDATE public.export_jobs 
      SET status = 'failed', error_message = SQLERRM, updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = job.id;
    END;
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_dev_route_telemetry(_event_type text, _blocked_path text, _user_role text DEFAULT NULL::text, _duration_ms integer DEFAULT NULL::integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _uid uuid := auth.uid();
  _safe_path text;
  _safe_role text;
  _safe_duration integer;
  _recent_count integer;
  _allowed_events constant text[] := ARRAY[
    'view',           -- usuário viu a tela 403
    'back',           -- clicou em "Voltar" (history -1)
    'retry',          -- clicou em "Tentar novamente" (mesmo path)
    'fallback',       -- foi para área segura (Início/Usuários/Catálogo)
    'request_access', -- clicou em "Solicitar acesso a Dev"
    'copy_link',      -- copiou o link da rota bloqueada
    'mail',           -- abriu cliente de e-mail
    'abandon'         -- saiu/fechou a aba (best-effort beacon)
  ];
BEGIN
  -- 1) Anônimo: ignora silenciosamente (não polui audit log).
  IF _uid IS NULL THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- 2) Whitelist de event_type (defense-in-depth).
  IF NOT (_event_type = ANY (_allowed_events)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid event_type: %', _event_type
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- 3) Sanitização (sem PII):
  --    - path: trim + corta em 200 chars (rotas internas são curtas).
  --    - role: corta em 32 chars; só aceita papéis conhecidos.
  --    - duration_ms: clamp em [0, 3_600_000] (1h).
  _safe_path := substring(coalesce(_blocked_path, '') from 1 for 200);
  IF length(_safe_path) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'blocked_path required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  _safe_role := substring(coalesce(_user_role, '') from 1 for 32);
  IF _safe_role NOT IN ('dev','admin','supervisor','agente','agent','vendedor','') THEN
    _safe_role := 'unknown';
  END IF;
  IF length(_safe_role) = 0 THEN
    _safe_role := NULL;
  END IF;

  IF _duration_ms IS NULL THEN
    _safe_duration := NULL;
  ELSIF _duration_ms < 0 THEN
    _safe_duration := 0;
  ELSIF _duration_ms > 3600000 THEN
    _safe_duration := 3600000;
  ELSE
    _safe_duration := _duration_ms;
  END IF;

  -- 4) Rate limit por usuário: 30 eventos/min.
  --    Usa o mesmo log para evitar tabela auxiliar.
  SELECT count(*) INTO _recent_count
  FROM public.admin_audit_log
  WHERE user_id = _uid
    AND action  = 'route.ux_event'
    AND source  = 'dev-route-ui'
    AND created_at > now() - interval '1 minute';

  IF _recent_count >= 30 THEN
    -- Excede orçamento: descarta silenciosamente para não amplificar abuso.
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- 5) Insere o evento. payload_summary intencionalmente mínimo (sem
  --    user_agent/IP/email — esses campos só são preenchidos por edge
  --    functions com service role e contexto de request).
  INSERT INTO public.admin_audit_log (
    user_id,
    action,
    resource_type,
    resource_id,
    status,
    source,
    started_at,
    finished_at,
    duration_ms,
    request_id,
    payload_summary,
    details
  ) VALUES (
    _uid,
    'route.ux_event',
    'route',
    _safe_path,
    CASE WHEN _event_type IN ('view','abandon','copy_link','mail') THEN 'denied'
         WHEN _event_type IN ('back','retry','fallback')           THEN 'partial'
         WHEN _event_type = 'request_access'                       THEN 'success'
         ELSE 'denied' END,
    'dev-route-ui',
    now(),
    now(),
    _safe_duration,
    gen_random_uuid()::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'event_type',   _event_type,
      'blocked_path', _safe_path
    ),
    jsonb_build_object(
      'event_type',   _event_type,
      'blocked_path', _safe_path,
      'user_role',    _safe_role,
      'duration_ms',  _safe_duration
    )
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_sicoob_order_status_event()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_status_changed boolean := OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status;
  v_sla_became_critical boolean := NEW.sla_status = 'critical'
    AND OLD.sla_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'critical';
  v_actor_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_comment text := NULLIF(
    left(trim(COALESCE(current_setting('app.sicoob_order_status_comment', true), '')), 1000),
    ''
  );
  v_title text;
  v_message text;
  v_type text;
  v_recipient_id uuid;
  v_order_reference text := upper(left(NEW.id::text, 8));
BEGIN
  IF NOT v_status_changed AND NOT v_sla_became_critical THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF v_status_changed THEN
    INSERT INTO public.sicoob_order_history (
      order_id,
      user_id,
      previous_status,
      new_status,
      comment
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.id,
      v_actor_id,
      OLD.status,
      NEW.status,
      v_comment
    );

    SELECT
      CASE NEW.status
        WHEN 'pending' THEN 'Novo pedido pendente'
        WHEN 'waiting_approval' THEN 'Aprovação de alçada requerida'
        WHEN 'escalated_to_board' THEN 'Pedido escalado para a Diretoria'
        WHEN 'confirmed' THEN 'Pedido confirmado'
        WHEN 'rejected' THEN 'Pedido rejeitado'
        WHEN 'logistic' THEN 'Pedido em logística'
        WHEN 'completed' THEN 'Pedido concluído'
        WHEN 'cancelled' THEN 'Pedido cancelado'
        WHEN 'draft' THEN 'Pedido devolvido para rascunho'
        ELSE 'Status do pedido atualizado'
      END,
      CASE NEW.status
        WHEN 'pending' THEN format('O pedido #%s foi enviado para análise.', v_order_reference)
        WHEN 'waiting_approval' THEN format('O pedido #%s aguarda uma aprovação de alçada.', v_order_reference)
        WHEN 'escalated_to_board' THEN format('O pedido #%s foi encaminhado para a Diretoria.', v_order_reference)
        WHEN 'confirmed' THEN format('O pedido #%s foi confirmado e seguirá para processamento.', v_order_reference)
        WHEN 'rejected' THEN format('O pedido #%s foi rejeitado. Consulte o histórico para mais detalhes.', v_order_reference)
        WHEN 'logistic' THEN format('O pedido #%s entrou na etapa de logística.', v_order_reference)
        WHEN 'completed' THEN format('O pedido #%s foi concluído.', v_order_reference)
        WHEN 'cancelled' THEN format('O pedido #%s foi cancelado.', v_order_reference)
        WHEN 'draft' THEN format('O pedido #%s voltou para rascunho.', v_order_reference)
        ELSE format('O pedido #%s mudou de status.', v_order_reference)
      END,
      CASE
        WHEN NEW.status IN ('confirmed', 'completed') THEN 'success'
        WHEN NEW.status IN ('rejected', 'cancelled') THEN 'error'
        WHEN NEW.status IN ('waiting_approval', 'escalated_to_board') THEN 'warning'
        ELSE 'info'
      END
    INTO v_title, v_message, v_type;

    FOR v_recipient_id IN
      WITH recipients AS (
        SELECT NEW.created_by AS user_id
          FROM public.profiles requester
         WHERE requester.user_id = NEW.created_by
           AND requester.is_active IS TRUE
           AND requester.deleted_at IS NULL

        UNION

        SELECT ur.user_id
          FROM public.user_roles ur
          JOIN public.profiles p ON p.user_id = ur.user_id
         WHERE p.is_active IS TRUE
           AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
           AND (
             (
               NEW.status IN ('pending', 'waiting_approval')
               AND (
                 ur.role::text IN ('admin', 'dev', 'supervisor')
                 OR (
                   ur.role::text IN ('gestor_compras', 'comprador_singular')
                   AND p.cooperativa_id = NEW.cooperative_id
                 )
                 OR (ur.role::text = 'gerente_pa' AND p.pa_id = NEW.pa_id)
               )
             )
             OR (
               NEW.status = 'escalated_to_board'
               AND ur.role::text IN ('admin', 'dev', 'supervisor')
             )
           )
      )
      SELECT user_id
        FROM recipients
       WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL
         AND user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_id
    LOOP
      INSERT INTO public.workspace_notifications (
        user_id,
        title,
        message,
        type,
        category,
        action_url,
        metadata
      ) VALUES (
        v_recipient_id,
        v_title,
        v_message,
        v_type,
        'pedidos',
        '/sicoob/pedidos/' || NEW.id,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'source', 'sicoob_order_status',
          'order_id', NEW.id,
          'previous_status', OLD.status,
          'new_status', NEW.status,
          'actor_id', v_actor_id
        )
      );
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  IF v_sla_became_critical
    AND NEW.created_by IS NOT NULL
    AND NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM v_actor_id
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM public.profiles requester
       WHERE requester.user_id = NEW.created_by
         AND requester.is_active IS TRUE
         AND requester.deleted_at IS NULL
    ) THEN
    INSERT INTO public.workspace_notifications (
      user_id,
      title,
      message,
      type,
      category,
      action_url,
      metadata
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.created_by,
      'Alerta: SLA crítico',
      format('O pedido #%s atingiu nível crítico de SLA.', v_order_reference),
      'error',
      'pedidos',
      '/sicoob/pedidos/' || NEW.id,
      jsonb_build_object('source', 'sicoob_order_sla', 'order_id', NEW.id, 'sla_status', NEW.sla_status)
    );
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reorder_sicoob_order_as_quote(p_order_id uuid, p_items jsonb, p_idempotency_key text, p_actor_id uuid, p_request_hash text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_quote_id uuid;
  v_valid_until timestamptz;
BEGIN
  v_valid_until := public.sicoob_assert_current_reorder_items(p_items);
  v_quote_id := public.reorder_sicoob_order_as_quote_legacy_20260927(
    p_order_id, p_items, p_idempotency_key, p_actor_id, p_request_hash
  );

  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.quotes q
    WHERE q.id = v_quote_id AND q.catalog_revalidated_at IS NULL
  ) THEN
    UPDATE public.quotes q
    SET reorder_source_order_id = p_order_id,
        catalog_revalidated_at = statement_timestamp(),
        catalog_valid_until = v_valid_until,
        catalog_stock_is_reserved = false,
        reorder_price_changed_items = (
          SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) source(item)
          WHERE COALESCE((item ->> 'price_changed')::boolean, false)
        )
    WHERE q.id = v_quote_id;

    UPDATE public.quote_items qi
    SET catalog_available_stock = (source.item ->> 'available_stock')::integer,
        catalog_minimum_quantity = (source.item ->> 'minimum_quantity')::integer,
        catalog_valid_until = (source.item ->> 'catalog_valid_until')::timestamptz,
        historical_unit_price = NULLIF(source.item ->> 'historical_unit_price', '')::numeric,
        price_changed = COALESCE((source.item ->> 'price_changed')::boolean, false),
        catalog_stock_is_reserved = false
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_items) WITH ORDINALITY AS source(item, ordinality)
    WHERE qi.quote_id = v_quote_id
      AND COALESCE(qi.sort_order, 0) = source.ordinality::integer - 1;
  END IF;

  RETURN v_quote_id;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_products_semantic(_query text, _products jsonb, _limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(product_id uuid, score double precision, matched_field text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit integer := greatest(1, least(coalesce(_limit, 20), 100));
  v_query text := lower(trim(_query));
BEGIN
  IF v_query IS NULL
     OR v_query = ''
     OR _products IS NULL
     OR jsonb_typeof(_products) <> 'array' THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH expanded AS (
    SELECT item, ordinality
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(_products) WITH ORDINALITY AS source(item, ordinality)
  ), products AS (
    SELECT
      (item ->> 'id')::uuid AS candidate_id,
      lower(coalesce(item ->> 'name', '')) AS candidate_name,
      lower(coalesce(item ->> 'description', '')) AS candidate_description,
      lower(coalesce(item ->> 'category', '')) AS candidate_category,
      lower(
        CASE jsonb_typeof(item -> 'tags')
          WHEN 'array' THEN coalesce((
            SELECT string_agg(tag, ' ' ORDER BY tag_ordinality)
            FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(item -> 'tags')
              WITH ORDINALITY AS tags(tag, tag_ordinality)
          ), '')
          WHEN 'string' THEN coalesce(item ->> 'tags', '')
          ELSE ''
        END
      ) AS candidate_tags,
      ordinality
    FROM expanded
  ), ranked AS (
    SELECT
      products.candidate_id,
      best.score,
      best.matched_field,
      products.ordinality
    FROM products
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT candidates.score, candidates.matched_field
      FROM (VALUES
        (
          extensions.similarity(products.candidate_name, v_query)::double precision,
          'name'::text,
          1
        ),
        (
          (extensions.similarity(products.candidate_category, v_query) * 0.8)::double precision,
          'category'::text,
          2
        ),
        (
          (extensions.similarity(products.candidate_tags, v_query) * 0.7)::double precision,
          'tags'::text,
          3
        ),
        (
          (extensions.similarity(products.candidate_description, v_query) * 0.5)::double precision,
          'description'::text,
          4
        )
      ) AS candidates(score, matched_field, tie_priority)
      ORDER BY candidates.score DESC NULLS LAST, candidates.tie_priority
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS best
  )
  SELECT
    ranked.candidate_id,
    ranked.score,
    ranked.matched_field
  FROM ranked
  WHERE ranked.score > 0.05
  ORDER BY ranked.score DESC, ranked.ordinality
  LIMIT v_limit;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_records_rerank(_query text, _candidates jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, score real, matched_field text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _q text;
BEGIN
  IF _query IS NULL OR length(trim(_query)) = 0 THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF _candidates IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(_candidates) <> 'array' THEN
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  _q := lower(trim(_query));

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH expanded AS (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(c->>'id', '') AS cid,
      lower(COALESCE(c->>'label', '')) AS clabel,
      lower(COALESCE(c->>'sublabel', '')) AS csublabel
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(_candidates) AS c
  ),
  scored AS (
    SELECT
      cid,
      GREATEST(
        extensions.similarity(clabel, _q) * 1.0,
        extensions.word_similarity(_q, clabel) * 0.9,
        extensions.similarity(csublabel, _q) * 0.7,
        extensions.word_similarity(_q, csublabel) * 0.6
      ) AS best_score,
      CASE
        WHEN extensions.similarity(clabel, _q) >= extensions.similarity(csublabel, _q) THEN 'label'
        ELSE 'sublabel'
      END AS field
    FROM expanded
    WHERE cid <> ''
  )
  SELECT cid, best_score::real, field
  FROM scored
  WHERE best_score > 0.05
  ORDER BY best_score DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sicoob_actor_can_approve(p_actor_id uuid, p_order_id uuid, p_board_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM public.sicoob_orders o
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.get_sicoob_order_approval_policy(o.id) policy
     WHERE o.id = p_order_id
       AND (
         NOT policy.forbid_self_approval
         OR o.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM p_actor_id
       )
       AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
           FROM public.profiles p
          WHERE (p.user_id = p_actor_id OR p.id = p_actor_id)
            AND (
              NOT policy.require_active_membership
              OR (p.is_active IS TRUE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL)
            )
            AND (
              EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
                 WHERE ur.user_id = p_actor_id
                   AND ur.role::text IN ('admin', 'dev', 'supervisor')
              )
              OR (
                NOT p_board_only
                AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
                   WHERE ur.user_id = p_actor_id
                     AND ur.role::text IN ('gestor_compras', 'comprador_singular')
                )
                AND p.cooperativa_id = o.cooperative_id
              )
              OR (
                NOT p_board_only
                AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM public.user_roles ur
                   WHERE ur.user_id = p_actor_id
                     AND ur.role::text = 'gerente_pa'
                )
                AND p.pa_id = o.pa_id
              )
            )
       )
  );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.submit_signed_quote_response(_token text, _response text, _signer_name text, _signer_document text, _signature_data_url text, _signer_ip text, _signer_user_agent text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF _signer_name IS NULL OR length(btrim(_signer_name)) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 200
     OR _signer_document IS NULL OR _signer_document !~ '^([0-9]{11}|[0-9]{14})$'
     OR _signature_data_url IS NULL OR length(_signature_data_url) NOT BETWEEN 40 AND 262144
     OR _signature_data_url !~ '^data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+$'
     OR length(_signer_ip) > 64 OR length(_signer_user_agent) > 512 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Dados da assinatura inválidos.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  RETURN public.apply_local_quote_approval_response(
    _token, _response, NULL, btrim(_signer_name), _signer_document,
    _signature_data_url, _signer_ip, _signer_user_agent
  );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_order_status_transition()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_transitions jsonb := '{
    "draft": ["pending", "cancelled"],
    "pending": ["waiting_approval", "cancelled"],
    "waiting_approval": ["confirmed", "rejected", "escalated_to_board", "cancelled"],
    "escalated_to_board": ["confirmed", "rejected", "cancelled"],
    "confirmed": ["logistic", "in_production", "cancelled"],
    "logistic": ["completed", "cancelled"],
    "in_production": ["in_separation", "cancelled"],
    "in_separation": ["in_transit", "cancelled"],
    "in_transit": ["delivered", "cancelled"],
    "delivered": ["completed", "cancelled"],
    "completed": [],
    "rejected": ["draft", "pending"],
    "cancelled": []
  }'::jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF OLD.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NEW.status THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NOT (
    v_transitions ? OLD.status AND
    NEW.status = ANY (ARRAY(
      SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(v_transitions -> OLD.status)
    ))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING
      ERRCODE = '23514',
      MESSAGE = format('Transição de status inválida: de %s para %s', OLD.status, NEW.status);
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.verify_quote_approval_signature(p_token_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'vault', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    t.signature_hash = encode(extensions.hmac(
      convert_to(t.signature_evidence::text,'UTF8'),
      convert_to(v.decrypted_secret,'UTF8'),'sha256'
    ),'hex')
    AND t.signature_evidence->>'quote_snapshot_sha256' = encode(extensions.digest(
      convert_to(public.quote_approval_content_snapshot(t.quote_id::uuid)::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'
    ),'hex'), false)
  FROM public.quote_approval_tokens t
  JOIN public.quote_approval_evidence_keys k ON k.id=t.signature_key_id
  JOIN vault.decrypted_secrets v ON v.name=k.vault_secret_name
  WHERE t.id=p_token_id AND t.signature_algorithm='hmac-sha256-v1'
  ORDER BY v.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1;
$function$
